from common import *
import gc, math, pickle


def main():
    save_source(__file__)
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate.ensemble_preds import blend_score_series
    from backtest.scripts.maintenance.experiment_archive import _validate_metadata

    progress = read(PROGRESS)
    assert not any(j["status"] == "running" for j in progress["jobs"])
    normal_end = progress["status"] == "evaluation_complete_awaiting_review"
    assert normal_end or progress["status"] in ["budget_stop_pending_closeout", "execution_stop_pending_closeout"]
    prepared = read(BASE / "configs/prepared-inputs.json")
    check(progress["source_amendment"])
    amendment = read(BASE / "configs/single-source-amendment.json")
    expected_groups = {(v, amendment["job_treatments"][v]) for v in VARIANTS}
    assert amendment["preserved_deadline"] == read(STATE)["deadline"]
    assert amendment["nominal_total_fits"] == 30
    a = pd.read_pickle(ROOT / prepared["variants"]["quantile7"]["new"]["path"])
    b = pd.read_pickle(ROOT / prepared["variants"]["quantile7"]["old"]["path"])
    assert a.index.equals(b.index) and np.array_equal(a.to_numpy(), b.to_numpy())
    del a, b
    for source in read(BASE / "docs/supplemental-control-inputs.json")["verified_files"]:check(source)
    expected_jobs = {(v, t, seed) for v, t in expected_groups for seed in SEEDS}
    started = {(j["variant"], j["treatment"], j["seed"]) for j in progress["jobs"]}
    succeeded = {(j["variant"], j["treatment"], j["seed"]) for j in progress["jobs"] if j["status"] == "succeeded"}
    assert started <= expected_jobs and succeeded <= expected_jobs
    assert len(succeeded) == sum(j["status"] == "succeeded" for j in progress["jobs"]), "duplicate successful scientific job"
    if normal_end:
        assert succeeded == expected_jobs
        assert all(progress["scientific_candidates"][v]["status"] == "completed" for v in VARIANTS)
    native = harness("status")
    assert set(native["jobs"]) == {j["job_id"] for j in progress["jobs"]}
    expected = read(PRIOR / "docs/inputs-h20.json")
    params = read(BASE / "configs/frozen-study.json")["parameters"]
    inputs, models = [], []
    for job in progress["jobs"]:
        nj = native["jobs"][job["job_id"]]
        assert nj["outcome"] == job["status"]
        for receipt in nj.get("evidence", []):
            check(receipt)
        if job["status"] != "succeeded":
            continue
        check(job["evidence"])
        r = read(ROOT / job["evidence"]["path"])
        for key in ["model", "input_receipt", "selected_valid_heads"]:
            check(r[key])
        inp = read(ROOT / r["input_receipt"]["path"])
        check(inp["label_receipt"])
        assert inp["label_receipt"] == prepared["variants"][job["variant"]][job["treatment"]]
        assert inp["feature_array_sha256"] == expected["feature_array_sha256"]
        assert inp["training"]["index_sha256"] == expected["training"]["index_sha256"]
        assert inp["validation"] == expected["valid_signature"]
        assert inp["tradable"] == expected["tradable_signature"]
        assert inp["parameters"] == params
        assert inp["training"]["shape"] == [5448963, 165]
        inputs.append(inp)
        es = r["early_stopping"][0]
        assert es["es_metric"] == "top5_h5_net_ann" and es["valid_days"] == 1448
        values = np.asarray(es["metric_history"])
        assert np.isfinite(values).all()
        assert len(values) == len(r["rounds"]) == len(r["tie_diagnostics"])
        assert es["best_iteration"] == int(values.argmax()) + 1
        assert es["best_score"] == float(values.max())
        assert es["early_stopping_rounds"] == 50 and es["num_boost_round"] == 200
        assert len(values) == min(200, es["best_iteration"] + 50)
        with (ROOT / r["model"]["path"]).open("rb") as handle:
            model = pickle.load(handle)
        assert model.model.best_iteration == es["best_iteration"]
        assert model.model.num_feature() == 164
        assert model.params == r["parameters"]
        assert model.params["seed"] == job["seed"]
        for key, value in params.items():
            if key not in ["num_boost_round", "early_stopping_rounds"]:
                assert model.params[key] == value
        del model
        gc.collect()
        models.append({"job_id": job["job_id"], "model": r["model"], "best_iteration": es["best_iteration"], "observed_rounds": len(values)})
    assert len({x["weights_sha256"] for x in inputs}) == (1 if inputs else 0)
    for variant in VARIANTS:
        for treatment in ["new", "old"]:
            labels = {i["label_values_sha256"] for j, i in zip([j for j in progress["jobs"] if j["status"] == "succeeded"], inputs) if j["variant"] == variant and j["treatment"] == treatment}
            assert len(labels) <= 1

    verified, unfinished_groups = [], []
    control_index = pd.read_pickle(ROOT / "backtest/result/20261105_horizon_p50/h20/horizonp50_20261105_h20_s42_pred.pkl").index
    for proof_path in sorted((BASE / "docs").glob("predictions-*.json")):
        proof = read(proof_path)
        receipt = progress["scientific_candidates"][proof["variant"]]["treatments"].get(proof["treatment"])
        if not receipt or receipt["status"] != "completed":
            assert not normal_end, "normal completion lacks a completed treatment receipt"
            unfinished_groups.append({"variant": proof["variant"], "treatment": proof["treatment"], "prediction_proof": fingerprint(proof_path), "reason": "Prediction proof exists but canonical evaluation receipt was not completed; group not numerically verified."})
            continue
        check(receipt["evaluation"])
        check(receipt["prediction_proof"])
        assert receipt["prediction_proof"] == fingerprint(proof_path)
        assert [c["seed"] for c in proof["components"]] == SEEDS
        predictions = []
        for item in proof["components"]:
            for key in ["model", "prediction", "training"]:
                check(item[key])
            matching = [j for j in progress["jobs"] if j["variant"] == proof["variant"] and j["treatment"] == proof["treatment"] and j["seed"] == item["seed"] and j["status"] == "succeeded"]
            assert len(matching) == 1
            assert item["training"] == matching[0]["evidence"]
            training_record = read(ROOT / item["training"]["path"])
            assert item["model"] == training_record["model"]
            assert item["session"] == matching[0]["session"] == training_record["session"]
            pred = pd.read_pickle(ROOT / item["prediction"]["path"]).iloc[:, 0]
            assert pred.index.is_unique and pred.index.equals(control_index)
            assert np.isfinite(pred.to_numpy()).all()
            predictions.append(pred)
        check(proof["ensemble"])
        actual = pd.read_pickle(ROOT / proof["ensemble"]["path"]).iloc[:, 0]
        recomputed = blend_score_series(predictions)
        assert actual.index.equals(recomputed.index)
        assert np.array_equal(actual.to_numpy(), recomputed.to_numpy(), equal_nan=True)
        result_path = BASE / "metrics" / f'{proof["variant"]}-{proof["treatment"]}.json'
        result = read(result_path)
        assert receipt["evaluation"] == fingerprint(result_path)
        check(result["diagnostic_heads"])
        assert result["label_grading"]["variant"] == proof["variant"]
        assert result["label_grading"]["treatment"] == proof["treatment"]
        assert result["label_grading"]["prediction_proof"] == fingerprint(proof_path)
        assert [s["seed"] for s in result["sessions"]] == SEEDS
        assert [s["session"] for s in result["sessions"]] == [c["session"] for c in proof["components"]]
        assert result["data_version"] == "2026-11-03"
        assert result["label_window_cutoff"]["h5"] == "2026-07-23"
        e = result["pools"]["all"]["ensemble"]
        assert e["head"]["3"]["5"]["n_days"] == 1448
        assert math.isfinite(e["h5"]["rank_ic_mean"])
        for key in ["net_ann", "net_ann_vol", "net_sharpe", "ann", "turnover"]:
            assert math.isfinite(e["head"]["3"]["5"][key])
        assert set(e["head_years"]) == {str(y) for y in range(2020, 2027)}
        assert set(e["head_regimes"]) == {"D", "F", "T"}
        verified.append({"variant": proof["variant"], "treatment": proof["treatment"], "rows": len(actual), "ensemble_recomputed_exact": True, "predictions": fingerprint(proof_path), "evaluation": fingerprint(result_path)})
        del predictions, pred, actual, recomputed
        gc.collect()
        print("Verified", proof_path.name, flush=True)

    observed_groups = {(r["variant"], r["treatment"]) for r in verified}
    assert observed_groups <= expected_groups and len(observed_groups) == len(verified)
    if normal_end:
        assert observed_groups == expected_groups

    control_receipt = BASE / "docs/control-evaluation-verification.json"
    unavailable_controls = []
    if control_receipt.exists():
        for r in read(control_receipt)["artifacts"]:check(r)
    else:
        assert not normal_end, "completed study lacks control evaluation"
        unavailable_controls.append(str(control_receipt.relative_to(BASE)))
    for year in range(2020, 2027):
        receipt = BASE / "docs" / f"inference-input-{year}.json"
        if receipt.exists():assert read(receipt)["control_prediction_exact"] is True
        else:
            assert not normal_end, "completed study lacks inference control proof"
            unavailable_controls.append(str(receipt.relative_to(BASE)))
    _validate_metadata(ROOT, BASE / "metadata.json", read(BASE / "metadata.json"), "model")
    write(BASE / "docs/final-numerical-verification.json", {
        "at": time.time(), "status": "complete" if normal_end else "partial", "models": models, "prediction_groups": verified,
        "coverage": {"expected_jobs": len(expected_jobs), "expected_prediction_groups": len(expected_groups), "missing_successful_jobs": sorted(expected_jobs - succeeded), "missing_prediction_groups": sorted(expected_groups - observed_groups), "unfinished_groups": unfinished_groups, "non_successful_attempts": [j for j in progress["jobs"] if j["status"] != "succeeded"]},
        "native_job_ledger_matches_supplemental": True, "user_source_amendment": progress["source_amendment"], "quantile7_old_new_exact_input_reuse_verified": True,
        "training_rows_features_masks_weights_parameters_verified": bool(inputs), "verified_training_input_count": len(inputs),
        "continuous_control_formal_inference_exact": not unavailable_controls, "unavailable_control_evidence": unavailable_controls,
        "source": fingerprint(BASE / "docs/adapter-verify_single.json"),
        "limits": "Verifies preserved evidence and ensemble arithmetic; the canonical metric implementation remains the source for financial metrics. Does not create an independent out-of-sample evaluation.",
    })
    print("Verification", "complete:" if normal_end else "partial:", len(models), "models;", len(verified), "prediction groups", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
